{{Quote|I don't care who you are or why you're here. If this is your animal, get it and get away from my house.|Fegred Ewd|<ref name="Ride Herd">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021205herd|text=Ride Herd|int=Ride Herd}}</ref>}}
'''Fegred Ewd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. After committing crimes on various worlds in [[Core Worlds/Legends|the Core]], including the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Ewd became a wanted criminal. He subsequently went into hiding on the planet [[Froswythe]] and he lived as a hermit. However, a group of vacationers inadvertently discovered Ewd's hiding place while herding [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] on Froswythe.
